entities.summary: Julia Lermontova was a Russian chemist. She is known as the first Russian woman to earn a doctorate in chemistry. She studied at the University of Heidelberg and the University of Berlin before she received her doctorate by the University of Göttingen in 1874. She was inducted to the Russian Chemical Society in 1875.
